4 new stories in the Rochdale borough since yesterday evening.

The stories:

Littleborough Christmas lights: Church Street restrictions confirmed for 28 November (Littleborough). Church Street restrictions are planned for Littleborough's Christmas lights event on Saturday 28 November, including a daytime waiting ban and an afternoon road closure.

Rochdale reception school applications for 2027: deadline, preferences and offer dates (Rochdale). Parents applying for a Rochdale borough reception place starting September 2027 have until 15 January. The council has also confirmed the offer date and rules for school preferences.

Missed the secondary school deadline in Rochdale? What parents need to do next (Rochdale). Rochdale's 31 October deadline has passed, but families can still apply for a Year 7 place for September 2027. Here is how late applications are handled and when offers are expected.

Mark Winstanley returns to stage after MS diagnosis for Rochdale comedy show (Rochdale). Actor Mark Winstanley will perform in 'Cabaret Schmabaret' at the Ukrainian Centre on 19 November, marking his return to the stage after a five-year hiatus due to multiple sclerosis.

Weather: Cloudy 11°C in Rochdale today.
